module: Node "Breakgroup" (category `repeat_p_duration`, tags destroy/damage). Breaks one or several breakgroups of the vehicle. Input pins: `vehId` (number), `group` (string, default `*`). `*` calls `beamstate.breakAllBreakgroups()`. If `vehId` is not connected, the node takes the player vehicle (`getPlayerVehicle(0)`).
notes: Bug: `type(self.pinIn.group.value == 'string')` compares first then takes the `type` of a boolean: the result is always 'boolean' (hence true), the "table" branch is never used despite the pin description ("table or string").
`beamstate.breakBreakGroup('name')`: the name is inserted as is between apostrophes in the Lua command.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: If `group` is `*`, breaks all breakgroups; otherwise calls `beamstate.breakBreakGroup('<group>')` on the vehicle. Exits if `group` is nil or if the vehicle is not found (E log).
